newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan tenders to buy July/August fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan tenders to buy July/August fuel oil.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy at least one 38,000-tonne cargo of 0.5-percent sulphur fuel oil for delivery between July 21 and August 15, a CPC official said on Thursday.
The tender, which seeks to buy low-pour fuel oil, will close on June 18 and offers will be valid for two days.
In its last purchase, CPC bought two 38,000-tonne cargoes of of low-sulphur fuel oil, with the low-pour cargo at $129 per tonne and the high-pour cargo at $123, for July deliveries.
